items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: But anyhow -- but Sammy Senior, that was the Will MASTEN trio. That was Sammy, Will, and his father -- SAMmy's father, see. Now, we worked together in -- wait a minute.

ctx.x: So one thing led to another??

Yeah, uh-huh. And let me see, I was on the bill with Buck and Bubbles and some big name I was on several times. No, that was before Sammy Davis, because I know Sammy, when Sammy was a little boy, he and his uncle, Will Masten and them --
